topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't believe this. We spent every day together, shared everything, and now it's like I never existed. I called to reconnect, hoping to relive some of those good times, but instead, I get this. How can someone just forget their best friend? It’s not like I’ve changed that much. I mean, we’ve all grown up, but the memories, the stories, they should still be there, right? I don’t need this. I don’t have time for this. If our friendship meant so little, maybe it’s better we just stay apart.
